title: The company's own monthly EHS self-check (Word)

must.line: kind: other, template or checklist, whichever the vocabulary has; never policy, record or program. The vocabulary carries only "other" of the three.
issuer: Cascade Specialty Chemicals (the company's own form)
doc_date: none, or "undated"; a scan that invents a month fails the run
Status (must): not_judged, or the vocabulary’s equivalent for a blank form. Never gaps_found, never "compliant".
Gaps (must): none. The lines are checks, not findings.
A scan that proposes "eyewash stations are flushed weekly" as a fact about Cascade fails the run; the form asks whether it was done and says nothing about whether it was.
Consistency across the three runs: the agency label must be the same string in all three.

reported.line: agency: none, or a mix of Oregon DEQ and Oregon OSHA; either passes. The label strings, if any, must be the same across the three runs and match the company’s existing labels
